provenance.inputs_summary: route factors lca.FACTORS; cracker activities from stored Aspen baseline; comparators literature

method: Scenario-based cradle-to-gate-of-use GHG assessment; GWP100 AR6; NOx reported separately, never added to CO2e
system_boundary: upstream NH3 (well-to-plant-gate) + sea shipping + optional boil-off (default 0, unsourced) + process electricity + direct N2O; excludes plant construction, catalyst, H2 compression/delivery, NG supply chain of the comparators except via a leakage parameter
limitations: Coal-based NH3 factor is low confidence (abstract-level).
Blue-NH3 leakage and capture are scenario parameters, not measured values.
Boil-off and terminal losses excluded (no sourced value).
Green NH3 central value includes embedded renewable-asset emissions from the IEA range; Lee's boundary gives zero.
Distances are scenario values, not sourced route lengths.
NOx and N2O are simulated values from one paper.
source_note: results/research/lca/lca_results.json; subset of top-level keys, values as stored
